text.description_html:
Laurey 38428, Ribbon Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel

The Satin Nickel Ribbon Cabinet Knob satisfies the want for simple cabinet hardware that still has character. These pretty Ribbon Cabinet Knobs will add a customer look to any lightweight door or drawer. The Laurey 38428 Ribbon Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel comes packaged with versatile mounting hardware to be sure you can easily install in in almost any application--be it in the kitchen, the bathroom vanity, or as a furniture drawer pull.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Ribbon Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38428 Satin Nickel Ribbon Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Satin Nickel Oil Rubbed Bronze Stonewashed Bronze

Sold Individually
